name: Summer of Memories
source:
It’s been years since you last visited the countryside – the place of childhood memories. When a surprise vacation with your mother brings you back there, the city boy inside you isn’t too keen. Little do you know, the three beautiful women you meet there will change your life. Now, the countryside has never been more exciting, and these three women give you reason to stay.

Whom will you choose? Your childhood crush, the beauty with big dreams? Or will you choose the passionate, hotheaded woman who knows just how to push your buttons? Or perhaps you will finally notice the shy, beautiful girl who always had a special place in her heart for you?

Each of them holds a secret…will you still love them for who they are?
translation:
你已经多年没有回到乡下——那个承载童年记忆的地方。母亲带你回去度假，城市男孩的你并不太情愿。你不知道的是，在那里遇见的三位美丽女性将改变你的人生。如今，乡下从未如此令人兴奋，而这三名女性也给了你留下来的理由。

你会选择谁？是怀揣伟大梦想的儿时恋人？还是知道如何精准拨动你心弦、热情又火爆的女人？抑或是那个总把你放在心中特殊位置、害羞而美丽的女孩？

她们每个人都藏着秘密……你还会因为她们真实的模样而爱上她们吗？
